name: pynecore-skills
description: Skills for PyneCore (Pyne) trading-strategy development in Python: writing and backtesting strategies and indicators (language rules, strategy API, data and the candle cache, ScriptRunner, multi-timeframe, live mode, FreqTrade integration, scaffolding, download, backtest, paper and live tools), the pyne CLI itself (every command and option, workdir, environment variables, non-interactive use), writing PyneCore plugins (the entry-point system and contracts, with tested templates: candles from files, CCXT over REST polling, Telegram notifications), working in PyneIDE projects (managed environment, generated files, editor commands), and offline lookup of the bundled PyneCore documentation.
